title: Wow! My Rocket Lamp! 🌙 Bedtime Routine with Baby Jimmy | Book, Dino, Blanket | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! Baby Jimmy's rocket night lamp switches on – it's bedtime! 🌙 Sing along with Baby Jimmy in his cozy star bedroom and learn a simple bedtime routine in three easy steps: first a book, then his dino, last his blanket.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! My rocket lamp! It's bedtime!"
📖 First, a book! Page, page, page!
🦖 Then my dino! Night night, dino!
🛏️ Last, my blanket! Snug, snug, snug!
🙆 Stretch with me! Yaaawn!
🤔 "What do we read at bedtime?" – can you answer?
👋 Book, dino, blanket – bedtime! Night night, friends!

📚 Kids learn: a bedtime routine in order (first, then, last) • bedtime • book • blanket • night night • getting ready for bed by myself

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along bedtime song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Jimmy in his pajamas getting ready for bed all by himself – a gentle way to make the evening routine easy and happy.
